user.title: Connect E.ON Next
user.description: Enter your E.ON Next API key. If you do not have one, follow the [API-key helper instructions](https://github.com/savagelands-net/homeassistant-eon-next#getting-an-api-key).

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect E.ON Next
reauth_confirm.description: E.ON Next now requires an API key. Enter the `sk_live_...` key to update this existing integration without losing its entities or history. See the [API-key helper instructions](https://github.com/savagelands-net/homeassistant-eon-next#getting-an-api-key).

reconfigure.title: Update E.ON Next API key
reconfigure.description: Enter the replacement `sk_live_...` API key. If you need to create one, follow the [API-key helper instructions](https://github.com/savagelands-net/homeassistant-eon-next#getting-an-api-key).

error.unsupported_tariff: This account does not expose a supported half-hourly tariff

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This API key belongs to a different E.ON Next account
